damageMultiplier.doc: Damage dealt by the unit with the effect.

transitionDamage.doc: Damage dealt upon transition to an affinity.

intervalDamageTime.doc: Spacing (in ticks) between interval damage. <=0 to disable.

intervalDamagePierce.doc: If true, interval damage is armor piercing.

parentizeEffect.doc: Should the effect be given a parent.

permanent.doc: If true, the effect never disappears.

reactive.doc: If true, this effect will only react with other effects and cannot be applied.

dynamic.doc: Special flag for the dynamic effect type with custom stats - do not use.

show.doc: Whether to show this effect in the database.

effect.doc: Effect that happens randomly on top of the affected unit.

applyEffect.doc: Effect that is displayed once when applied to a unit.

applyExtend.doc: Whether the apply effect should display even if effect is already on the unit.

parentizeApplyEffect.doc: Should the apply effect be given a parent.

affinities.doc: Affinity & opposite values for stat displays.

opposites.doc: Affinity & opposite values for stat displays.

outline.doc: Set to false to disable outline generation.
